'''Phoenix Base''' is a surface Engineer base in the '''[[Meene]]''' system, and the workshop of '''[[Ram Tah]]'''.<ref name="inara-phoenix-base">[https://inara.cz/elite/station/55499/ Phoenix Base in Meene — Station], Inara.</ref>

Ram Tah relocated his long-running study of the long-extinct Guardians to Phoenix Base after United Meene Labour agreed to fund his research programme, making Meene a hub for Guardian research alongside its role as an Engineer base.<ref name="inara-phoenix-base" />

== Location ==

* '''System:''' [[Meene]]
* '''Landing pad:''' Large
* '''Permit required:''' No<ref name="inara-phoenix-base" />

== Engineer ==

Phoenix Base is operated by '''[[Ram Tah]]'''. Ram Tah is reached through a referral from [[Lei Cheung]] — see [[Ram Tah]] for the full discovery, invitation, and unlock requirements to access his workshop.

== Station Services ==

Phoenix Base offers a commodity market, outfitting, repairs, shipyard services, and a technology broker, in addition to Ram Tah's Engineering workshop.<ref name="inara-phoenix-base" />
